summary: flush uses a magic count of five microtasks; fake-timer tests use synchronous advanceTimersByTime, so no microtasks run between interval callbacks (which is why FND-0170 mutation goes unnoticed; advanceTimersByTimeAsync would let responses settle); the console.error spy is restored inline and leaks if an assertion fails
failure_scenario: Too-small flush count gives a false red, not a false green. Spy leak has no effect today since the test is last.
